assumptions: The input tree's branch lengths were estimated from the full alignment, and pruning keeps them.
limits: Pruning the tree is not rebuilding without those taxa; the two give different answers.
Collapsing by support discards a topology the data weakly preferred.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: A re-rooted, pruned, ladderised or collapsed tree is an edit of the input, returned whole; there is no estimate to read.
bio.jane/contract.question: What does this tree look like re-rooted, pruned, ladderized, or with weak branches collapsed?

description: Edit a tree that is already built — re-root it (at its midpoint, on an outgroup, or remove the root), prune taxa away or down to a set, ladderize it, or collapse branches that are too weakly supported or too short to believe. Pruning the TREE keeps the branch lengths estimated from the full alignment, which is a different answer from rebuilding without those taxa.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

ascending.description: ladderize small clades first, rather than large. Only applies when operation is ladderize.

max_length.description: collapse any branch shorter than this (0 = do not). Only applies when operation is collapse.

min_support.description: contract any branch whose support is below this (0 = do not). Only applies when operation is collapse.

newick.description: the tree to edit — wire `newick` from build_tree, or paste one.

operation.description: what to do to the tree. Values: reroot-midpoint (Re-root at the midpoint), reroot-outgroup (Re-root on an outgroup), unroot (Remove the root (unroot)), prune-keep (Prune down to these taxa), prune-remove (Prune these taxa away), ladderize (Ladderize (presentation only)), collapse (Collapse weak or short branches).

position.description: where along the outgroup edge the root lands, 0 = at the outgroup, 1 = at its sister. Only applies when operation is reroot-outgroup. Advanced.

taxa.description: tip labels — the outgroup for a re-root, or the taxa to keep/remove for a prune. Only applies when operation is reroot-outgroup or prune-keep or prune-remove.

name: transform_tree

statistics.description: statistics RE-DERIVED for the edited tree, because rerooting or pruning changes them and the previous numbers beside a changed tree would be wrong. Absent for `ladderize`, which only reorders tips and changes no statistic

tipCount.description: tips remaining — the number to check after a prune
